label: GO step, later in the episode (episode-time ramp)
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (100% of mass at GO; never at D2, essentially never at D1). Inside GO it does not depend on choice, state, transition, reward, stay/switch or good state (all lifts about 1.0x). What it depends on is time within the episode. It is almost silent in the first trials (rate 0% at trials 0-2, about 10% at trials 0-19) and fires on about all GO steps from about trial 40 on. Its magnitude keeps growing with episode trial: trials 90-99 hold 48% of the activation mass and trials 80-89 hold 27%, while trials before 50 hold under 3%. So it behaves like an episode clock gated to GO. Plain phase==GO already gets F1 0.89 (precision 0.81). Adding ep_trial>=30 lifts dev F1 to 0.92 (precision 0.96, mass recall 0.996). The weakest activations it misses are GO steps in trials 20-30. Activations are larger when the policy is confident (large |choice| at GO), but that partly follows from GO-only firing and was not used. Only observed or internal variables are used.

issues: Minor factual misstatement: the reported 'rate about 10% for trials 0-19' is the rate over all steps (D1, GO and D2). Within GO the feature fires on about 30-34% of steps in trials 0-19. Dev: (phase==GO)&(ep_trial<20) has precision 0.324 on 62222 GO steps, and the per-10-trial rates over all steps are 0.099 and 0.113, which is about 0.30-0.34 per GO step. These early firings are very weak (mass recall 0.002, almost all in the bottom activation quartile), so the 'episode clock' reading still holds.
'Almost silent for trials 0-2' is roughly right. Trials 0-1 are about 0, but trial 2 fires on about 18% of GO steps (ep_bucket 2 all-step rate 0.061). Over GO with ep_trial<3, precision is 0.092.
The ep_trial>=30 threshold is a soft cutoff on a smooth ramp, not a sharp boundary. ep_trial>=25 gives test F1 0.921 and ep_trial>=20 gives 0.915, against 0.917 at >=30. The differences are trivial.

I found no systematic false-positive class among late GO steps that do not fire. Uncertain choices (|choice|<2), next_stay==0, stay==0, recent reversals (since_rev<5) and D1 errors all still have precision of 0.89-0.99, so the remaining false positives are scattered noise. Misses (test: 39349 steps, 0.5% of mass) are weak GO activations before trial 30, with no choice, transition, reward or good-state pattern.

Verified: 100% of activation mass is at GO, D2 has 0 activations and D1 has 82 of 307030. Within GO, lifts for action, state, common, reward, stay, next_stay, good and core_pattern are all about 1.0x. Mass grows steeply with episode trial (90-99: 0.476, 80-89: 0.274, under 3% before trial 50). Test scores reproduce: P 0.962, R 0.876, F1 0.917, mass recall 0.995. No future variables are used. Adding choice confidence does not help (test F1 0.917 for GO&(ep_trial>=30 | (ep_trial>=10 & |choice|>8))).
